;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Mortars are fired at the diplomatic quarter of [[Kabul]] during a speech by President [[Ashraf Ghani]]. After several hours of fighting, including a helicopter attack on a building behind the [[Id Gah Mosque]], police say the attackers are dead and four people are wounded. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45256161 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Venezuela earthquake]]
**A magnitude 7.3 [[earthquake]] strikes off the coast of [[Venezuela]], prompting building evacuations in [[Caracas]]. Buildings shake across Caribbean and South America's North coast. Several buildings are destroyed. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/22/venezuela-earthquake-caracas-hit-caribbean (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.newsweek.com/venezuela-earthquake-70-quake-shakes-trinidad-and-tobago-grenada-nearby-1084239 (''Newsweek'')]
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**Footage from the [[United States Geological Survey]] shows lava activity at [[Kīlauea]] slowing down. [http://www.khq.com/story/38932431/watch-new-usgs-footage-shows-kilauea-volcano- (KHQ)]

;International relations
*[[El Salvador]] severs diplomatic relations with [[Taiwan]], opting to instead establish ties with [[China]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/881253a2-a4ef-11e8-8ecf-a7ae1beff35b (''Financial Times'')]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] imposes sanctions on two [[Russia]]n shipping companies and six vessels for involvement in oil transfer to [[North Korea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-northkorea-russia-sanctions/u-s-sanctions-russian-firms-vessels-over-north-korea-oil-transfers-idUSKCN1L61LV (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Grand jury investigation of Catholic Church sexual abuse in Pennsylvania]]
**The [[University of Scranton]] removes the names of three former Catholic bishops ([[James Timlin]], [[J. Carroll McCormick]] and [[Jerome Hannan]]) implicated in a [[Sexual abuse scandal in the Catholic dioceses of Pennsylvania#2016-2018 investigation into six Pennsylvania dioceses|grand jury report on abuse]] in [[Pennsylvania]] from its campus buildings. [https://www.thetimes-tribune.com/news/university-of-scranton-stripping-scranton-bishops-names-from-buildings-1.2376097 (''Times-Tribune'')] [https://www.cnn.com/2018/08/21/us/university-of-scranton-buildings-pa-catholic-scandal-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Pursuit of Nazi collaborators]]
**Jakiw Palij, a 95-year-old suspected [[Nazi]] [[Trawniki concentration camp]] guard in 1943, is [[List of people deported or removed from the United States|deported]] from the [[United States]] to [[Germany]]. [http://time.com/5372947/nazi-war-criminal-deported-germany/ (''Time'')]
*[[Michael Cohen (lawyer)|Michael Cohen]], the ex-lawyer of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], pleads guilty to eight felony financial charges. He admits that a $150,000 [[hush money]] payment in August 2016, "at the direction" of an unnamed candidate, was for the "principal purpose of influencing" the [[2016 United States presidential election|2016 presidential election]]. He is released on $500,000 bail until his sentencing on December 12. He faces up to 65 years, though prosecutors recommend 46 to 63 months. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/crime-courts/ex-trump-lawyer-michael-cohen-discussing-plea-deal-prosecutors-n902571 (NBC News)]
*[[Trials of Paul Manafort]]
**Former [[Donald Trump]] [[Donald Trump presidential campaign, 2016|campaign]] chairman [[Paul Manafort]] is found guilty on eight charges for false tax returns and bank fraud. [https://amp.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2018/aug/21/michael-cohen-latest-live-news-updates-trump-lawyer-plea-deal-charges (''The Guardian'')]
*[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] [[Duncan D. Hunter]] ([[Republican Party (United States)|R]]–[[California's 50th congressional district|CA]]) and his wife are charged with wire fraud, falsifying records, campaign finance violations and conspiracy. In the indictment unsealed today, federal prosecutors allege that the Hunters illegally used campaign funds to pay personal bills. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/08/21/politics/duncan-hunter-campaign-charges/index.html (CNN)]
*In the [[United States]], inmates in 17 states go on strike to protest [[prison labor]] conditions. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2018/aug/20/prison-labor-protest-america-jailhouse-lawyers-speak (''The Guardian'')]
*A court in [[Vietnam]]’s [[Ho Chi Minh City]] begins the trial of twelve people, including two Vietnam-born Americans, on charges of attempting to overthrow the government. [http://www.latimes.com/world/la-fg-vietnam-activists-trial-20180821-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill, 2018]]
**[[Australia]]n [[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Malcolm Turnbull]] survives a challenge by conservative Home Affairs Minister [[Peter Dutton]] for leadership of the [[Liberal Party of Australia|Liberal Party]], with 48 votes to 35. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2018/aug/21/liberal-leadership-dutton-turnbull-energy (''The Guardian'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Ice]] is confirmed at the [[Moon]]'s poles. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-45251370 (BBC)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/moon-ice-discovery-water-frozen-nasa-craters-space-a8500566.html (''Independent'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2018/aug/20/ice-found-on-moon-surface (''The Guardian'')]
*The mass of exoplanet [[Beta Pictoris b]] is measured directly for the first time through [[astrometry]], giving it a mass of {{val|11|2}} [[Jupiter mass|Jupiter masses]], and marking one of the first times an exoplanet was detectable through measuring its effect on the host star's location. [https://phys.org/news/2018-08-infant-exoplanet-hipparcos-gaia.html (Phys.org)]

;Sports
*[[Swimming at the 2018 Asian Games]]
**[[Liu Xiang (swimmer)|Liu Xiang]] breaks the [[World record progression 50 metres backstroke|50-metre backstroke swimming world record]], setting it at 26.98 seconds, to win the [[Swimming at the 2018 Asian Games – Women's 50 metre backstroke|women’s gold medal]] at the [[2018 Asian Games|Asian Games]]. [http://www.espn.com/espnw/sports/article/24434159/china-liu-xiang-breaks-50-meter-backstroke-world-record-asian-games (ESPN)] [https://in.reuters.com/article/games-asia-swimming-record/asian-games-chinas-liu-swims-world-record-time-to-win-50m-backstroke-gold-idINKCN1L6121 (Reuters India)]
